subject: Renewal confirmation: additional GPUs and tenancy boundary
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian@nebula.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal confirmation: proposed capacity add and tenancy boundary

Hi Julian —

Thanks again for the conversation today. As discussed, Nebula Labs is approaching renewal and would like to add reserved capacity at the start of the new term. Summary of the ask: 

- Add 8x A100 GPUs to your Dedicated pool (for model inference workloads)
- Logical tenant separation (reserved pool with fencing so Nebula traffic does not share KV/cache or baking nodes)
- Maintain current routing/region in us-west and preserve existing model pinning

Can you confirm the following so we can include it in the renewal amendment?

1) Expected start date for the expanded capacity (we were thinking 2027-06-15)
2) Any preferred maintenance window for rollout (UTC)
3) Any specific throughput/latency targets you want encoded in the SLA addendum (e.g., p95 generation latency, or tokens/s throughput)

I'll loop in Ops to prepare a runbook and topology diagram; we can attach a first-draft runbook for review once we confirm dates. I'll also include a DocuSign quote for the term amendment.

Thanks — please reply with the particulars and I'll take it from there.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear summary. We want to move forward with the expansion. A few specifics from our side: 

- Start date: target 2027-06-20 (we need the week buffer to coordinate internal release)
- Maintenance window: prefer 02:00–06:00 UTC on a Saturday (minimize US traffic)
- SLA: we can commit to the following targets to measure against once capacity is live: p95 generation latency <= 450ms for typical 1k token responses; sustained throughput target 10k tokens/sec per pool during peak. If you have existing benchmarks for the proposed config, share those and we can align.

Also, procurement wants the DocuSign quote and a brief runbook that describes the isolation guarantees and rollback steps so legal/procurement can sign off. Could you include a short network diagram showing VPC separation and any ACLs?

Julian Park

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal confirmation: proposed capacity add and tenancy boundary

Hannah / Neha —

Thanks — tagging in the technical plan for the Nebula expansion. High-level notes from Infra/Serving: 

- Pool: we'll provision a new dedicated pool named nebula-prod-1 with 8x A100 (40GB) nodes.
- Isolation: logical fencing will be enforced at the serving layer: separate KV namespaces, separate prefix cache, and no shared worker processes for tenant-bound requests. Network-level separation: dedicated subnets + security groups; we will optionally enable private peering to Nebula's VPC if they prefer (TBD).
- Throughput: based on our internal benchmarks for 8xA100 + continuous batching we expect sustained ~11k tokens/sec at customer workload profile; p95 generation latency ~350–420ms for 1k-token outputs (depends on model and quantization). We'll include measured numbers in the runbook.
- Rollout: staged capacity warmup across 3 waves over 48 hours with canary traffic (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Canary checks: tail latency, token error rates, and model output drift against the stored eval prompt set. Automatic rollback on defined thresholds.

I'll attach the initial runbook and topology diagram — please validate the maintenance window and start date before we schedule provisioning.

Attachments: [nebula-pool-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF)], [nebula-topology-diagram.png (image)]

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Julian —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the procurement note. Confirming the plan below for the amendment and run schedule: 

- Start date: 2027-06-20 (as requested)
- Maintenance window: Saturday 2027-06-19 02:00–06:00 UTC for staged provisioning and warmup (we will only route full traffic after successful canary wave 3)
- Pool config: nebula-prod-1, 8x A100 (40GB), logical tenancy fencing (separate KV cache + prefix isolation)
- SLA targets to be included in the amendment: p95 generation latency <= 450ms (1k tokens); sustained throughput goal 10k tokens/sec. We will capture baseline metrics on rollout and include measured numbers in the runbook appendix.
- Credits: as a renewal goodwill we will include a one-month service credit equivalent to 10% of the added capacity cost, applied to the first invoice after activation.

Attached: initial runbook and topology diagram for review. Next steps:
1) Julian/procurement to confirm acceptance of start date and maintenance window
2) We'll issue the DocuSign amendment once you confirm (link included below)
